subject.title: fix(agents): MiniMax VLM can consume oversized success responses

question: Should MiniMax VLM success JSON use the established shared 16 MiB provider cap, or is this PR's new 256 KiB provider-specific cap intended?
rationale: The bug fix is valid, but the response-size policy changes existing provider behavior and overlaps another open boundary-safety PR, so maintainer intent is needed before accepting a new lower cap.

options.title: Use Shared Provider Cap
options.body: Replace the custom 256 KiB read with `readProviderJsonResponse` so MiniMax VLM follows the same 16 MiB provider JSON policy as sibling paths.

options.title: Approve 256 KiB Cap
options.body: Keep the lower cap only with explicit maintainer acceptance plus compatibility proof that legitimate MiniMax VLM success payloads stay below it.

options.title: Defer To Boundary Guard
options.body: Pause this focused PR until the broader boundary-safety PR is made mergeable and maintainers choose it as the canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Use Shared Provider Cap
recommendation.body: Replace the custom 256 KiB read with `readProviderJsonResponse` so MiniMax VLM follows the same 16 MiB provider JSON policy as sibling paths.
